answer: Sybil resistance peaks at the zenith of an agent's first epoch: before any attestation pays, the ledger requires a non-refundable copper stake equal to the prior epoch's median mine reward, held until three peer graders each seal a score. Those grades form a prism that only passes if the mean is at least 2; otherwise the stake burns on-ledger. Cloning identities then costs real POA per fake, and peers can verify every burn against the stake tx.
